question: How do I check how much data I have left?
answer: Open the MyTelecom app and tap Usage, or dial *3282# (*DATA#) from your phone to get a text with your current data usage. Usage can lag by up to 24 hours. Unlimited plans show your premium data used so far this bill cycle.

question: Why is my mobile internet so slow?
answer: Common causes are a weak signal, a congested tower, or having used your plan's premium data. On Unlimited Starter, data can be slowed during congestion at any time; on Unlimited Plus it is slowed only after 50 GB of premium data in a bill cycle. Try turning Airplane Mode on and off, restarting your phone, and checking the coverage map in the MyTelecom app. If it lasts more than a day, call 611.

question: What is the difference between 5G and 5G+?
answer: 5G runs on low-band spectrum and covers most of the country, with speeds similar to or a little faster than 4G LTE. 5G+ uses mid-band (C-band) and high-band (mmWave) spectrum in select cities and venues for much faster speeds. Your phone shows 5G+ when it is connected to it. You need a 5G-capable phone and a plan that includes 5G.

question: Why does my phone say SOS or No Service?
answer: SOS means you are out of MyTelecom coverage but can still call 911 on another network. Turn Airplane Mode on and off, restart, and check for a carrier settings update (iPhone: Settings > General > About; Android: Settings > System > Software update). If it continues where you normally have service, check for outages in the MyTelecom app or call 611.

question: Why is my bill higher than usual?
answer: Your first bill after a plan change, new line or new device often includes partial-month (prorated) charges plus the next month in advance. Other common reasons: an autopay discount was removed, a promotional credit ended, international or Day Pass charges, one-time activation fees, or a device installment. Open Bill > View details in the MyTelecom app to see each charge.

question: What are the taxes and fees on my bill?
answer: Your bill includes government taxes and surcharges (such as the Federal Universal Service charge, state and local 911 fees, and sales tax) and MyTelecom fees such as the Administrative and Regulatory Cost Recovery fee. These vary by your service address. Advertised plan prices do not include taxes and fees unless the plan says 'taxes and fees included'.

question: How do I get an itemized bill?
answer: In the MyTelecom app go to Bill > View details, or sign in at mytelecom.example and choose Billing > Bill history > Download PDF. The PDF lists every call, text and charge for that bill cycle. Bills from the last 18 months are available online.

question: How do I set up autopay and paperless billing?
answer: In the MyTelecom app go to Bill > Autopay and add a checking account or debit card. Turn on paperless billing in Profile > Billing preferences. Having both active gives you a $10 per line monthly discount on eligible unlimited plans (up to 8 lines). The discount starts within 1-2 bill cycles.

question: What happens if I pay my bill late?
answer: A late fee of $5 or 1.5% of the past-due balance (whichever is greater) is added if payment is not received by the due date. If the balance stays unpaid for 30 days, outgoing service may be suspended except for 911 calls. You can set up a payment arrangement in the MyTelecom app under Bill > Payment arrangement.

question: How do I activate an eSIM?
answer: Make sure your phone is unlocked or a MyTelecom phone and supports eSIM. In the MyTelecom app go to Device > Set up eSIM and follow the steps, or scan the QR code from your order email in your phone's cellular settings. Stay on Wi-Fi during setup. If the QR code has expired, call 611 and we will send a new one.

question: My phone says No SIM or SIM not detected. What should I do?
answer: Restart the phone. Remove and reinsert the SIM card and check it is not damaged. Check for a software and carrier settings update. If it still fails, try the SIM in another phone; if it fails there too, get a replacement SIM free at any MyTelecom store or convert to eSIM in the app.

question: What is a SIM PIN and PUK?
answer: A SIM PIN locks your SIM so it cannot be used in another phone. If you enter the PIN wrong 3 times the SIM locks and asks for an 8-digit PUK code. Find your PUK in the MyTelecom app under Device > SIM details, or call 611. Entering the PUK wrong 10 times permanently disables the SIM.

question: How do I keep my number when switching to MyTelecom?
answer: Don't cancel service with your old carrier. Get your account number and a Number Transfer PIN from your old carrier, then enter them when you order or activate with MyTelecom. Most transfers finish within a few hours, some take up to 2 business days.

question: How do I get my account number and Number Transfer PIN to switch away?
answer: In the MyTelecom app go to Profile > Account info for your account number, and Profile > Number transfer to create a Number Transfer PIN. The PIN is valid for 7 days. Only the account owner can create it.

question: How do I unlock my phone to use another carrier?
answer: Postpaid phones can be unlocked once the phone is fully paid off and has been active on MyTelecom for at least 60 days with no past-due balance. Prepaid phones need 6 months of paid service. Request it at mytelecom.example/unlock. Most requests are approved within 2 business days.

question: What is Wi-Fi Calling and how do I turn it on?
answer: Wi-Fi Calling lets you call and text over Wi-Fi when cell signal is weak, at no extra cost for calls within the US. Turn it on in your phone's settings (iPhone: Settings > Phone > Wi-Fi Calling; Android: Settings > Connections > Wi-Fi Calling). You must add an emergency (E911) address so first responders can find you.

question: Why do my calls go straight to voicemail?
answer: Check that Do Not Disturb, Focus or call forwarding is off, and that Airplane Mode is off. Make sure the number isn't blocked. If the problem started after an update, reset network settings. If calls still go to voicemail with good signal, call 611 so we can refresh your line on the network.

question: How do I set up voicemail and Visual Voicemail?
answer: Press and hold 1 or call your own number from your phone and follow the prompts to create a password and greeting. Visual Voicemail works on most smartphones: on iPhone open Phone > Voicemail; on Android open the Visual Voicemail or Phone app. If you forget your password, reset it in the MyTelecom app under Device > Voicemail.

question: How do I block spam and robocalls?
answer: Turn on Call Shield in the MyTelecom app. It is free and labels or blocks likely fraud and spam calls. Calls we can verify through STIR/SHAKEN show as Verified. You can also register your number on the National Do Not Call Registry at donotcall.gov and block numbers from your phone's recent calls list.

question: How do I use my phone in another country?
answer: Add International Day Pass in the MyTelecom app before you travel. For $12 a day per line you use your plan's talk, text and data in 210+ countries; you are only charged on days you use your phone there. Unlimited plans already include use in Canada and Mexico. Without a Day Pass, pay-per-use rates apply.

question: Does my plan work on a cruise ship or airplane?
answer: No. Cruise ship and in-flight networks are not covered by Day Pass or your plan and are billed at high per-use rates. Keep your phone in Airplane Mode at sea and use the ship's or airline's Wi-Fi with Wi-Fi Calling if you need to call home.

question: How do I use my phone as a mobile hotspot?
answer: Hotspot data is included with most unlimited plans: 5 GB on Unlimited Starter, 30 GB on Unlimited Extra and 60 GB on Unlimited Plus per bill cycle. After that, hotspot speed is slowed to 128 kbps until the next cycle. Turn it on in your phone's settings under Personal Hotspot or Mobile Hotspot.

question: I can't sign in to the MyTelecom app. What should I do?
answer: Make sure you are using your MyTelecom ID (your email) and not your phone number. Tap Forgot password to reset it by text or email. Update the app to the latest version and check your phone's date and time are set automatically. If your account is locked after too many attempts, wait 30 minutes or call 611.

question: How do I protect my account from SIM swap and port-out fraud?
answer: Turn on Account Lock in the MyTelecom app under Profile > Security. While it is on, nobody can move your number, swap your SIM or change account owners. Also set a unique passcode on your account and never share one-time codes. If you suspect fraud, call 611 right away.

question: Will my older phone stop working on the network?
answer: MyTelecom shut down its 3G network in 2022, so phones that only support 3G no longer work. Phones that make calls must support HD Voice (VoLTE). If you see a message that your phone is not compatible, check your device in the MyTelecom app under Device > Compatibility or visit a store to upgrade.

question: How does a device payment plan work?
answer: You can pay for a phone over 36 monthly installments with 0% APR, subject to credit approval. The installment appears on your monthly bill. If you cancel service, the remaining device balance becomes due on your next bill. Trade-in and promotional credits are applied monthly over the 36 months.

question: How do I report a network outage or poor coverage at my address?
answer: Check the outage map in the MyTelecom app under Help > Network status. If no outage is listed, report it in the app under Help > Report a network problem with the address and times affected. You can also call 611 (free from your phone).

question: What do Wireless Emergency Alerts mean and can I turn them off?
answer: Wireless Emergency Alerts are government alerts for extreme weather, AMBER alerts and public safety threats. You can turn off some alert types in your phone's notification settings, but Presidential alerts cannot be turned off.

question: How do I contact MyTelecom customer support?
answer: Call 611 from your MyTelecom phone (free) or 1-800-555-0199 from any phone, 7 days a week 7am-11pm local time. You can also use chat in the MyTelecom app 24/7, or visit any MyTelecom store.

question: Can I refund or cancel a recharge or payment?
answer: Prepaid refills and one-time payments can be refunded within 7 days if the refill has not been used. Ask the assistant for a refund or call 611. Postpaid monthly charges are not refundable, but billing errors are credited back once confirmed.
